get.description: Returns per-day counts of schedule tasks and calendar items across company projects for the specified date range. Tasks and calendar items whose start–finish window overlaps the range are included.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Start date of the range to summarize (inclusive).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: End date of the range to summarize (inclusive). Maximum span is 90 days from `after`.

parameters.name: limit_per_day
parameters.description: Maximum number of projects returned per day.

parameters.name: project_owner_type_ids
parameters.description: Filter by project owner type IDs.

parameters.name: resource_ids
parameters.description: Filter tasks by schedule resource IDs.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: When true, counts only summary tasks.

parameters.name: milestone
parameters.description: When true, counts only milestone tasks.

parameters.name: assignee_ids
parameters.description: Filter calendar items by assignee user IDs. When present, task counts are omitted.

parameters.name: sort_key
parameters.description: Property used to sort projects within each day. Defaults to descending `project_event_count`.

schema.description: Per-day company schedule summary across projects.

data.description: Summary rows, one per day in the requested range that has events.

date.description: Start of the day in UTC for which counts are reported.

projects_count.description: Number of projects with tasks or calendar items on this day.

projects.description: Projects with task or calendar item counts on this day. Size is limited by `limit_per_day`; order follows `sort_key` and `sort_dir`.

items.description: Project with counts. `tasks_count` is present only when greater than 0. `calendar_items_count` is present only when greater than 0.

tasks_count.description: Number of schedule tasks on this day.

calendar_items_count.description: Number of calendar items on this day.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/schedule/summary?after=SOME_STRING_VALUE&before=SOME_STRING_VALUE&limit_per_day=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&project_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_stage_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_type_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_department_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_office_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_region_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_owner_type_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&program_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&resource_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&query=SOME_STRING_VALUE&summary=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&milestone=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&project_role_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&assignee_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&milestone_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&sort_key=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort_dir=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
